166: And there are 365 sinews in a person - they correspond to 365 commandments that were given to not do; and correspond to the days of the year. And behold that the Ninth of Av is one of them. For it corresponds to Samael (the prosecuting angel), who is one of these 365 angels (another version: days). And because of this, the Torah said, "the Children of Israel do not eat et the sciatic nerve." Et is to include the Ninth of Av, that we not eat on it and we do not drink.
